meta.topic: Banking System Database Deadlock Interview Question
meta.title: Interviewer Ne Pucha: Database Deadlock Kaise Handle Karoge?
meta.instagramCaption:
Interviewer ne pucha agar do users ek hi second mein same bank accounts se paise transfer karein, toh Database Deadlock kaise rokoge? 🤯💼

Here is how Senior Engineers answer in FAANG, TCS & Startup tech rounds:
1. Problem: Transaction A locks Acc 1 & waits for Acc 2, while Transaction B does the reverse ➔ DEADLOCK!
2. Naive mistake: Running plain un-sequenced SQL update queries.
3. Senior Solution #1: Resource Ordering (always lock in ascending Account ID order).
4. Senior Solution #2: Redis Distributed Lock with auto-expiry & backoff.

Comment 'DEADLOCK' below and I will send you the complete System Design & Concurrency Cheatsheet! 🚀

scenes.headline: INTERVIEWER NE PUCHA AGAR...
scenes.voice: Interviewer ne pucha agar do users ek hi second mein same bank accounts se paise transfer karein, toh Database Deadlock kaise rokoge?

scenes.headline: DATABASE DEADLOCK DETECTED!
scenes.voice: 90% freshers bolte hain: 'Sir, simple SQL query se update kar denge!' Lekin reality ye hai ki Transaction A Account 1 ko lock karega, aur Transaction B Account 2 ko — aur system instantly freeze ho kar crash ho jayega!

scenes.headline: RESOURCE ORDERING & REDIS LOCK!
scenes.voice: Senior engineer ne smile kiya aur bola: 'Sir, do solutions hain. Pehla — Resource Ordering, jahan locks hamesha ascending Account ID order mein acquire honge. Aur doosra — Redis Distributed Lock with auto-expiry!'

scenes.headline: COMMENT 'DEADLOCK' FOR NOTES!
scenes.voice: Interviewer bola: 'Brilliant! You are hired!' Agar TCS, Infosys aur FAANG ke system design rounds crack karne hain, toh comment karo 'DEADLOCK' aur hum bhejenge poori cheatsheet!
